messages:
Nina (Presales): Heads-up 10am sync with Verdant Health. Scope: streaming SDK + tool/function calls + strongly-typed JSON outputs. They also want CMEK and EU data residency. Need quick checklist and any urgent blockers. cc @Omar K @Ben T
Omar K: For streaming we recommend SSE for browser clients, websocket for backend. Example handshake (pseudo): ```
// init over ws
SEND { action: 'init', client_id: 'verdant-123', format: 'funcschema-v2' }
// on tool call
RECV { type: 'tool_call', tool: 'patient_lookup', args: { id: 'abc' } }
```
Omar K: Note: set keepalive=30s and window_size=16 for expected load.
Ben T: On CMEK/residency: Dedicated and Private support CMEK. Hosted EU region stores tokens and logs in eu-1 unless they explicitly request cross-region. Need signed DPA for residency SLA.
Nina (Presales): They asked about credential rotation cadence and audit logs retention.
Eva L: Rotation: short-lived tokens (default 1 hour) with automatic rotation; for Dedicated Private we support customer KMS rotation policies. Audit logs retention is configurable (30/90/365 days) depending on plan.
Nina (Presales): Technical Q: can tool calls return binary blobs (e.g., PDFs) in payload?
Omar K: Best practice: tool returns payload as base64 within JSON payload field. For large files use presigned URL from customer's storage. Also mind streaming backpressure if payloads are large 1 use chunked tool responses with part_index.
Ben T: Pricing note for ~100k tokens/day: hosted is simplest; estimate depends on tokenization and model choice. If they need <50ms median p99 then Dedicated is likely. I'll draft price ranges (hosted vs reserved).
Nina (Presales): Integration gotcha they flagged: their API gateway strips unknown headers and rewrites Content-Type. Could break our fncall handshake.
Omar K: If gateway mutates headers, switch to embedding client_id in initial WS payload and sign it. Also include HMAC of init payload to prevent tampering.
Nina (Presales): They also want a tiny dev guide for their engineers (15-20 lines code + handshake steps). Could someone produce that?
Omar K: I can make a 12-line Node example and a curl fallback snippet.
Eva L: I'll attach a short SOC2 + KMS note and our CMEK matrix after this thread.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-04-12 to staging completed (samples/sdk-streaming updated).
Ben T: Action items: Nina gather concurrency, avg seq length, p95/p99 latency target, and completed security questionnaire. Omar produce 12-line SDK snippet + curl fallback. I will prepare tentative pricing bands and residency/contract notes.
Nina (Presales): Thanks team 1 I'll send the security form to Verdant and update here. Follow-up sync at 10:15am tomorrow.
Ben T: :thumbsup:
